name: gb-transit-map
description: Transit map overlays of Britain's railways from OpenStreetMap

scripts.setup: npm run loom && npm run osm
scripts.loom: [ -d vendor/loom ] || (git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/ad-freiburg/loom.git vendor/loom && git -C vendor/loom apply ../../patches/loom-svg-precision.patch); cmake -S vendor/loom -B vendor/loom/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release >/dev/null && cmake --build vendor/loom/build -j8 --target topo loom transitmap
scripts.prebuild: [ -x vendor/loom/build/topo ] || npm run loom; [ -f vendor/osm/great-britain-latest.osm.pbf ] || npm run osm
scripts.build: npm run linegraph && npm run topo && npm run tidy && npm run check && npm run render && npm run preview && npm run tracks
scripts.linegraph: mkdir -p out && node src/linegraph.ts vendor/osm/great-britain-latest.osm.pbf out/gb.routes.json out/gb.names.json > out/gb.linegraph.json
scripts.tidy: node src/tidy.ts out/gb.topo.json out/gb.routes.json out/gb.linegraph.json | vendor/loom/build/loom > out/gb.map.json
